title: Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN): An Analysis of Adaptive Action Grids in Decoupled Q-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Value-based Q-learning for continuous control can discretise the action space, but the resolution of the discretisation trades early exploration against final precision. Growing Q-Networks (GQN) grow the resolution uniformly from coarse to fine. We introduce Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN), which keeps decoupled Q-learning and replaces uniform growth with an adaptive action grid: bins are added next to bins with high estimated Q-value, bins with low Q-value are pruned, and actions are chosen epsilon-greedily. On eight DeepMind Control Suite (DMControl) tasks with 2 to 12 action dimensions, SGQN has the highest mean final return among the compared methods on four, is within 1.1% of the best method on three more, and is 3.4% below Bang-Bang MPO on Walker Run, using on average 7.5 of 9 available bins per dimension. We then test whether the adaptive grid explains these results, and find that it does not. Growth activates every candidate

translated_title: 选择性生长Q网络：解耦Q学习中自适应动作网格的分析
translated_abstract: 基于价值的Q学习用于连续控制时可以对动作空间进行离散化，但离散化的分辨率需要在早期探索与最终精度之间进行权衡。生长Q网络（GQN）从粗到细均匀地增加分辨率。我们提出了选择性生长Q网络（SGQN），它保留了去耦合Q学习，并用自适应动作网格取代均匀增长：在具有高估计Q值的bin旁边添加新的bin，剪除低Q值的bin，并以epsilon-贪婪方式选择动作。在具有2到12个动作维度的八个DeepMind Control Suite（DMControl）任务上，SGQN在四个任务上取得了所有对比方法中最高的平均最终回报，在另外三个任务上与最佳方法的差距在1.1%以内，在Walker Run任务上比Bang-Bang MPO低3.4%，每个维度平均使用9个可用bin中的7.5个。随后我们检验自适应网格是否能解释这些结果，发现它并不能。增长会激活每个候选……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出选择性生长Q网络（SGQN），在解耦Q学习中用自适应动作网格（在高Q值区域附近增加bin、剪除低Q值bin并采用epsilon-贪婪动作选择）取代均匀分辨率增长，在多个DMControl连续控制任务上取得优异表现，但消融分析发现自适应网格本身并不能解释这些性能优势。
